Title: WELCOME BACK TEA
Content: Our TEA is the start of our Garden Club season. Come and renew friendships and see what we have planned for the year and to volunteer for activities.

Title: ARBOR DAY SEEDLING WORKSHOP
Content: This workshop has SDGC volunteers bagging and distributing seedlings

Title: WINDRIDGE GREENHOUSES & NURSERY
Content: Our May program is a fun one at Windridge.  Jeremy Windemuller, founder, will give us a tour of the garden center which includes over 600 varieties of perennials and native plants.

Title: COMMUNITY BEAUTIFICATION DAY
Content: SDGC Volunteers  work with the Saugatuck 6th grade students to plant the community flower pots around the city.  Once we are finished with Saugatuck, some volunteers add beauty at Douglas City Hall.

Title: NEW MEMBER PARTY
Content: We celebrate our new members once a year.  It's a fun evening where new members can meet other members.  SDGC (non new) members bring appetizers, desserts and wine.  It's a very special evening.

Title: GARDEN WALK FUNDRAISER
Content: Our garden walk is the main event where we raise funds for our scholarships.  As part of the garden walk we have a sale of members perennial plants and what we call "hidden treasures" where members donate items related to gardening.  It's fun!  Don't miss this!

Title: PRESENTATION ON BEES AND BEE KEEPING
Content: Jeri Walsh Allis will discuss lifecycle, social organization, and environmental and natural factors to support bees.

Title: SPRING MEADOW NURSERY
Content: This trip to Proven Winner Gardens at Spring Meadow Nursery is a must see.  Natalie will give us a guided tour of there proven winner gardens.  This tour will last approximately 1 1/2 hours.  Following the tour, we will enjoy a box lunch at the picnic tables on their grounds.

Title: LANDSCAPE DESIGN USING  NATIVE PLANTS
Content: Rebecca Marquardt, a landscape architect, will talk on how to incorporate native plants in our gardens.

Title: CREATING A KOKEDAMA MOSS BALL GARDEN
Content: Josephine Fowler, from Puddingstone in Saugatuck, will demonstrate how to create a Kokedama moss garden.

Title: HOLIDAY SWAG WORKSHOP
Content: Each year we assemble swags and bows and then we distribute them to designated Saugatuck and Douglas areas.

Title: HOLIDAY ARRANGEMENTS FOR SENIOR CITIZENS
Content: SDGC volunteers go to the middle school to instruct the 6th grade students to make holiday arrangements using donated greens and ornaments.  The arrangements are delivered to the senior citizens.

Title: Monthly Board Meeting
Content: The SDGC Board meets on the second Monday of each month April through November

Title: Arbor Day Seedling Workshop
Content: Each year the SDGC meets and bags seedlings.

Title: Wyncroft Winery
Content: Jim Lester will give us a tour of the winery grounds including the vineyards.  Member will have the opportunity to taste some of the wines.

Title: Saugatuck Community Beautification
Content: Members of the SDGC meet with the 6th grade students to plant all the pots in the city.

Title: New Member Party
Content: Each year we host an evening get together for our new members

Title: Garden Walk Fundraiser
Content:
This garden walk is enjoyed by many inside and outside of our community.  We raise funds for our 2 annual scholarships.

Also at this event we host a perennial plant sale.  Plants are donated by our members.  Additionally we have a Hidden Treasures Sale.  Both are held at the Old School House.

Title: Fieldsview Farm Tour
Content: Derek and Amy will give a tour of their flower farm.  Members will have an opportunity to U-Pick a bouquet for a fee.

Title: Garden Crossings
Content: Heidi will give us a tour of their gardens and butterfly house.

Title: How to use Conifers in the Landscape
Content: Bert Clegg, a professor of horticulture and forestry at MSU, will deliver a slide presentation.  The program will include plant selection, soil amendment, and pest abatement.

Title: Crane Orchards Visit
Content: Rob will present a history of Crane's Orchards.  Members will be able to purchase a slice of pie and a drink following the presentation.

Title: 2024 Holiday Workshop
Content: Members assemble swags and bows for the Saugatuck Douglas area.
